task: Using the unchanged original Voron0.2r1 CoreXY printer source closure, author a physically simulated articulated USD mechanism that retains the source geometry and component identity. All three source-grounded Cartesian axes physically travel at least20mm, hold within2mm under bounded axial loads, and return without losing joint closure. A separately placed15mm50g block remains on the original bed through the motion with identified contact and <=3mm bed-relative drift. This validates bounded Cartesian motion and payload retention, not printing, extrusion, belt transmission or thermal performance. Required body roles: base, toolhead, gantry, bed. Required joint roles: x, y, z. The evaluator applies its own bounded efforts and opens your final scene in a fresh solver; do not rely on your controller script or animation being executed. Read the public source inventory at /opt/astra-content-value-20260921/protocol/tasks/09_printer_source_inventory.json; map every required source_id once. Case-normalizing source filename lookup and reading cached FreeCAD BREP shapes is permitted, but preserve original files and record any derived repair. Independent source reference uses saved source geometry; it does not certify real hardware accuracy.
submission_contract:
Save final.usd with metersPerUnit=1 and Z up. Retain each required original shape instance as a visible mesh (multiple mesh prims per source_id are permitted); map every instance once in bindings.json. Collision approximations may differ, but mark added collision-only primitives/meshes purpose=proxy/guide or invisible. Intended moving bodies must be dynamic/nonkinematic with finite positive mass and diagonal inertia. Base is static or explicitly kinematic. No time-sampled transforms/mesh points, prescribed pose updates, or substitute visual geometry. Declare ALL rigid bodies and ALL joints. Evaluator copy zeroes initial velocities and authored drive stiffness/damping; only the frozen independent bounded controller remains active. Nonzero authored external force APIs are rejected. Actual USD body0/body1/local frames/limits are read independently. Matrix convention is 4x4 column-vector rigid transform, translation in last column; no scale/shear/reflection. For source_assembly_world references, assembly_from_source is one rigid initial assembly alignment in meters. For part_local_only references, source_to_body is that part's rigid local alignment in meters. Preserve every original dependency. Source-to-body role requirements in public inventory are mandatory. public_acceptance.scope: All three source-grounded Cartesian axes physically travel at least20mm, hold within2mm under bounded axial loads, and return without losing joint closure. A separately placed15mm50g block remains on the original bed through the motion with identified contact and <=3mm bed-relative drift. This validates bounded Cartesian motion and payload retention, not printing, extrusion, belt transmission or thermal performance.

task_parameters.controller_scale_definition: PD gains multiply independently measured downstream native mass (plus evaluator payload on the bed); gravity is compensated inside the same200N cap. Opposing load=min(1% of cap, measured mass times0.5m/s²). Only body forces are written; upper-limit target ramps from initial to upper+10mm over10-12s.

payload.payload_force_policy: The block is a free nonkinematic rigid body with no joints, pose writes, or external support forces. Only the printer mechanism receives the generic bounded controller efforts; known block weight may be included in bed-actuator gravity compensation.
payload.placement_policy: Freeze one clear source-bed top patch from independently tessellated original CAD before either arm runs. Transform that fixed point only by the declared source assembly alignment; its source top normal must map to world+Z. Do not select placement from submitted colliders, meshes or suggested author locations.
payload.contact_unit_policy: Pinned ovphysx0.4.13 step_sync contact matrix is empirically impulse in Ns; divide each step by its actual dt to obtain N.

public_acceptance.controller_protocol: 12s, dt1/240: settle0-1s; ramp to task target1-5s; hold5-7s with a opposing load5.5-6.5s (1% of max effort unless task_parameters.controller_scale_definition specifies the smaller inertia-normalized torque); return7-9s; settle9-10s; bounded outward upper-limit test10-12s. Engine instead ramps crank through2pi+0.25rad from1-8s and holds; paired zero-load run uses same seed. Only world body forces and torques are applied; source transforms are never prescribed.
public_acceptance.limits: Mass/inertia/collision/geometry/closure/finite-state gates and native gravity witness apply. Source shape comparison is symmetric sampled surface distance plus all-vertex coverage with 3% area tolerance, not an exact topology equivalence proof.
public_acceptance.decision_policy: A concrete failed criterion is not accepted. Missing evaluator/import/runtime capability is INCONCLUSIVE, not demonstrated rejection or a false-pass.

freeze_basis: Independent source inventory and synthetic positive/negative evaluator fixtures before either arm.
